data.text/markdown:
LSTM Encoder-Decoder: dry

Sequence-to-sequence model for CNR prediction. Encoder compresses CNR + stim features history → hidden state. Decoder takes hidden state + future stim features → predicted CNR. Autoregressive rollout with teacher forcing (annealed).
param value
source synthetic_v2
hidden_dim 16
num_layers 2
history_len 15
future_len 10
lr 0.001
epochs 50
batch_size 128
patience 20
tf_ratio_start 1.0
tf_ratio_end 0.0
dry_run True
dropout 0.1

Data: 30000 trajectories × 100 timepoints (synthetic_v2) Encoder input: CNR + 9 stim features (u_t, m_t, recency, ewma_fast, ewma_slow, n_5, slope_5, burst_pos, s_cum) over 15 history steps Decoder input: 9 stim features over 10 future steps → predicts CNR Train: 5000 windows | Val: 1250 | Test: 5000

model type params

Baseline Seq2SeqBaseline 7,889
encoder_in=10 | decoder_in=9 | hidden=16 | layers=2 | mps
